title: Finite local constancy passes to refinements
statement: If a sheaf is finite locally constant on every stratum of S and T refines S, then it is finite locally constant on every stratum of T.

source.place: topological invariance, together with Tags 095A and 03Q1 (3)

proof.text: For each image containment form the fibre product of the two immersed strata. Its projection to the refined stratum is a surjective immersion, hence a closed immersion and universal homeomorphism. Pull back the original finite locally constant sheaf along the other projection, using a pulled-back trivializing cover and stalk comparison. Identify the two composite inverse images. Descend the trivialization along the equivalence of small etale sites; geometric points lift through the closed immersion, so finite stalks descend too.

theorem refinement_preserves_finite_lisse
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (T S : Stratification X) (hTS : T.Refines S)
    (hS : ∀ k : Fin S.n,
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
        ((etaleSetPullback (S.immersion k)).obj F)) :
    ∀ i : Fin T.n,
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
        ((etaleSetPullback (T.immersion i)).obj F)
